_uitleg: Bron voor kamelo.eu/news (tools/news.mjs). Elke versie uit CHANGELOG.md komt er vanzelf op; hier staan alleen eigen titels per versie en mijlpalen zonder versie. Zonder titel hier gebruikt news.mjs het eerste vetgedrukte punt uit de changelog. Met "url" linkt de kaart naar een eigen artikel op kamelo.eu (bijv. /news/ask-privately.html) in plaats van naar de changelog.

1.3.3.title: Security update
1.3.3.text: Empty frames on a page can no longer read details you masked on another site. Found in our own review; no known abuse.

1.3.2.title: Mask text, anywhere
1.3.2.text: Paste text in the popup and Kamelo masks it, for places it can't reach itself. Paste the answer back to restore it.

1.3.1.title: A welcome page on kamelo.eu
1.3.1.text: After installing, a short page shows how to pin Kamelo and try it on ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude.

1.3.0.title: A vault per site
1.3.0.text: Details masked on one site are only restored on that same site. Plus: this month's count and a calm notice for sensitive topics.

1.2.1.title: One address for contact
1.2.1.text: Contact and Report a problem now go to one Kamelo email address.

1.2.0.title: A new name: Kamelo
1.2.0.text: A new name, a blue chameleon, and a shorter notice that shows what the AI sees.

1.1.3.title: Lock your vault with Touch ID
1.1.3.text: Lock and unlock the vault from the popup, and Kamelo now works in tabs that were already open.

1.1.2.title: Quieter after updates
1.1.2.text: Open tabs no longer show errors after Kamelo updates. Masking keeps working.

1.1.1.title: Masking works everywhere again
1.1.1.text: A fix for a bug that stopped Kamelo from masking anything in Chrome.

1.1.0.title: Kamelo remembers names
1.1.0.text: A masked name is recognised later in other forms, like a first name or lowercase, with the same placeholder.

1.0.0.title: First release
1.0.0.text: Kamelo masks personal data on your device before it reaches AI, and puts the real values back in the answer.

1.4.1.title: Private Chat is here
1.4.1.text: Ask personal questions in your own chat. In Chrome, the AI answers on your own computer, so nothing is sent. And Kamelo catches more names, addresses and keys.

milestones.title: Kamelo is open source
milestones.text: Every line of the extension is public on GitHub, under AGPL-3.0.
